edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the total settlement amount of Four Hundred Twenty-Five Thousand Dollars (US $425,000) (the “Settlement Amount”) within five (5) business days after the Effective Date and Defendant’s receipt of complete wire/payment instructions and any required tax documentation, including a completed IRS Form W-9 or other applicable tax form. Plaintiff shall be solely responsible for any taxes, interest, penalties, reporting obligations, or withholdings arising from or relating to the Settlement Amount, and no representation is made by Defendant regarding the tax treatment of the Settlement Amount.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential, except that either party may disclose such terms: (a) to its attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, auditors, insurers, reinsurers, and other professional advisors who have a need to know and are informed of the confidential nature of the information; (b) to the extent required by law, court order, subpoena, regulatory authority, or applicable tax or reporting obligation; (c) to enforce the terms of this Agreement; or (d) as otherwise agreed in writing by the parties. Any permitted disclosure shall be limited to the extent reasonably necessary under the circumstances.
